segments.title: Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour broadcast sign-on and countdown.

segments.title: Pre-Show Housekeeping
segments.notes: Case discusses fish tie pricing, Discord thread mishap for town hall audience submissions, and confirms Beyblade Burst goal met.

segments.title: Destruction Type Beat Derailment
segments.notes: Hype Train abandons subscriber acknowledgments for a 15-minute freestyle rap cycle about crack, piss, and city hall insurrection.

segments.title: Riyadh Comedy Festival Controversy
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple break down the Saudi state-sponsored comedy festival lineup (Chappelle, Hart, Burr, CK, etc.), debate sportswashing ethics, and read Jim Jefferies/Theo Von podcast transcripts defending participation.

segments.title: Trailer Reviews: One Piece, Wolverine, Cannibal Girls
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple hosts trailers segment: One Piece S2 (cautious optimism), Wolverine game (zero bubs, robot blood), 1973's Cannibal Girls (bell warning gimmick).

segments.title: Robbie Love Call-In: Skate Ties vs Fish Ties
segments.notes: Robbie Love argues skating is objectively better than wearing ties; reveals mother cut contact over the opinion and is now addicted to methamphetamines.

segments.title: Crack/Piss Pharmacokinetics & Spaghetti Fracture Mechanics
segments.notes: Chet and ChetAI explain crack detection windows (squat max dependent) and the physics of why dry spaghetti snaps into 3+ pieces (cascading failure, solved 2005).

segments.title: Crum vs. 30 Hell Concubines
segments.notes: Crum denies ever being in hell, fathering hell-spawn, or being attracted to demons; audience votes off claimants including El Manchester, a pot of gold named Lampert, and a furry creature who knew Crum's safe word (Jiff uncrustables) and numby rag.

segments.title: Song Production: 'Into the Wall (Crappy T-Shirt)'
segments.notes: DJ C4 and guest artist Gizbo write/record a Celtic dwarf-rock track about delving into the wall, gypsum drunkenness, poly-cotton blends, and piss/crack stains; dedicated to Carl.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid
segments.notes: Case teases Beyblade Burst Wednesday, spaghetti dinner, and raids out.

Wife posted about safe word on Instagram.
Alter ego 'El Manchester' resides in hell per concubine testimony.
Worked as maintenance man in the wall; best friend 'Grandman' (blob man) lost there.
Full Beyblade Burst arena purchased by Munch; Beyblades ordered, delivery expected by Wednesday.
Dry spaghetti almost always fractures into 3+ pieces due to cascading failure from recoil shockwave; twisting before bending yields clean two-piece break (MIT 2005).

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a Monday broadcast dominated by a Hype Train derailment into crack/piss freestyling, a news breakdown of the Riyadh Comedy Festival's controversial comedian lineup, trailer reviews from Jeff Ripple, a Robbie Love call-in about skating ties, Chet's science of spaghetti physics, and an In Circle session where Crum denies fathering hell-spawn with 30 demon concubines. The broadcast closes with DJ C4 and guest artist Gizbo producing a Celtic dwarf-rock lament about the wall yielding only a crappy t-shirt, and Case teasing a Beyblade Burst event for Wednesday.
